description: Price a same-day courier delivery in the Chicago area with Comet Messenger Service (since 1976). Returns live prices for Streak (fastest), Priority and Standard service, and the vehicle used. Quotes only - nothing is booked. Account holders' agents can book with book_delivery; everyone else books by calling (312) 786-2288 or at https://cometmessenger.delivery.

dropoff_street.description: Drop-off street address, e.g. '300 N LaSalle St'

pickup_street.description: Pickup street address, e.g. '300 N LaSalle St'

round_trip.description: True when the courier returns to the pickup (default false)

vehicle.description: Vehicle wanted; 'auto' (default) picks from the weight. A heavier load is moved up to the vehicle it needs.

weight_lb.description: Total weight in pounds. Picks the vehicle when none is given.

when.description: Pickup time, Chicago time, e.g. '2026-10-05T10:00'. Optional; used to flag after-hours and weekend pricing.

name: get_quote

overtime_pct.description: Present when 'when' was given: surcharge % for that time

title: Get a Comet delivery price
